tei:div.tei:p: 278) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: 'gro 'dul 'phags pa'i dbang gi cha lag gab thig bzhugs: na mo padma kā ra ye:

rdo rje thod phreng rtsal la 'dud: phyi rabs 'phags pa'i dkyil 'khor du: 'jug phyir dbang gi yan lag mchog: gab thig zab mau 'di ru bkod: skal ldan bu yis nyams su longs: sa ma ya: dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni: na mo: dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i dpal: 'gro 'dul 'phags pa'i dkyil 'khor la: bdag ni gus pas skyabs su mchi: byang chub bar du bskyab tu gsol: lan gsum rjes su bzlos: gnyis pa sems bskyed ni: hoḥ ma gyur 'gro ba sems can kun: rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas phyir: 'gro 'dul 'phags pa'i dkyil 'khor du: yang dag lam 'jug sems bskyed do: lan gsum rjes zlos bya: gsum pa yan lag brgyad pa ni: hoḥ bla ma lha yi dkyil 'khor du: sgo gsum mi phyed dad pa yi: gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal lo: dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis sprul: rnam gsum dag pa'i mchod pa 'bul: so thar byang sems gsang sngags kyi: sdom bslab dam tshig nyams pa bshags: slob pa'i lam nas 'phags pa'i sar: dge tshogs kun la 280)rjes yi rang: 'gro ba gang la gang 'dul gyi: chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskulaḥ rgyal dang de sras byang sems tshogs: mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs: dus gsum bsags pa'i rnam dkar dge: ma gyur 'gro ba yongs la bsngoḥ kun kyang tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs nas: phyam gcig rdzogs sangs rgyas gyur cig: tshig mjug lan gsum rjes zlos bya: bzhi pa dam chu sbyin pa ni: slob dpon gyis: 'o: skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams nyon cig: dngos grub thams cad kyi 'byung gnas dbang dang: dbang gi srog dam tshig yin pas slob dpon gyis bsgo ba'i bka' bzhin sdom pa gsum gyi gnad las nam yang 'da' bar mi bya'o snyam pa'i ngang nas rdo rje'i dam tshig gi chu 'di g.yas kyis long la hub gsum bya'o: lhag ma cung zad g.yon rgyab tu dor la sngar byas sgo gsum gyi nyes pa thams cad sbyang bar bsam la:

hūm̐: 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje'i chu: khyod kyi ngag tu blud pa yis: dam bsrung tshe 'dir dngos grub brnyes: mchog gi rig 'dzin sa thob 'gyur: dam las 'das na mes tshig nas: na raka gnas su lhung bar nges: de phyir dam tshig tshul bzhin srungs: badzra sa ma ya na ra kan: 281) sngags rjes zlos bya: lnga pa mig dar 'ching ba ni: ma rig pa'i ling thog bsal ba'i phyir dar dmar gyis gdong bcings ba'i mos pa mdzod: oṃ tsakṣu bhandha wā ra ma ṇa ye swā hā: drug pa me tog sbyin pa ni: sngon 'brel gyi lha dang mjal ba'i phyir me tog gi phreng ba re 'dzin pa'i mos pa mdzod: oṃ a khaṃ wi ra hūm̐: bdun pa slob ma lhar bskyed pa ni: las chu 'thor la: oṃ ma hā shu n+ya tā= sogs: haṃḥ gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gi chos thams cad stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las bdag mdun gsal snang sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mthus: slob ma'i rgyud kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib gdos bcas kyi phung po dang bcas pa thams cad 'ja' tshon nam mkha' la yal ba ltar chos dbyings stong pa chen po'i ngang du zhig par gyur: stong pa'i ngang las: ma chags padma nyi zla'i steng: slob ma skad cig dran rdzogs su: 'gro 'dul 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs: dkar gsal zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa: dang pos thugs kar thal mo sbyar: 'og gnyis shel phreng pad dkar 'dzin: zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs: 282) sku la longs spyod rgyan rnams rdzogs: spyan gyis 'gro la brtse bar gzigs: mtshan dpe zhi ba'i tshul dgu ldan: de ltar gsal ba'i gnas gsum las: 'od 'phros dbyings bzhugs ye shes lha: spyan drangs bskyed pa'i lha la thim: brgyad pa byin 'bebs ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ 'og min gnas dang mkha' spyod zhing: po ṭa la dang rnga yab gling: dag pa'i zhing khams rab 'byams na: bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems dang: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnal 'byor tshogs:

'gro 'dul 'phags pa'i rnam rol du: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren byin chen phobs: slob ma'i sgo gsum byin gyis rlobs: lus la sku yi dbang byin phobs: rdo rje'i sku ru smin par mdzod: ngag la gsung gi dbang= rdo rje'i gsung du byin gyis rlobs: yid la thugs kyi dbang= rdo rje'i thugs su grol bar mdzod: phyi nang gzhan gsum sku gsum klong: yongs grub chen par byin chen phobs: sku gsung thugs kyi dbang mchog stsol: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ gu ru arya lo ki shwa ra sarba sa pā ri wā ra badzra sa ma ya dza dza pheṃ pheṃ a be sha ya a āḥ 283) me tog 'thor bzhin: ye shes dbab pa de nyid slob ma'i sgo gsum la rab tu gnas nas ji srid sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du brtan par gyur cig: tiṣṭha badzra tiṣṭha badzraḥ zhes brjod dbang gzhung nyid du 'jug: sa ma ya: de ltar dbang gi gab thig zab mo 'di: 'phrul gyi brda btab gter gyi srung mar gtad: ma 'ongs skal ldan gcig dang 'phrad par smon: gter ston e 'ong gter bdag rang la rag: las dang smon lam rten 'brel ma log dgos: snyigs ma'i 'gro ba'i bsam spyod a re sdug: g.yo sgyus rgyud gang brdzun tshig sa steng spel: rang bstod gzhan smod lkog tu nag chang spyod: dkor nag dug 'tsho'i zas la rtsi bzhin mthong: la yog sdug bsngal sna tshogs rin gyis nyo: de'i dus dam tshig zol zog med pa yis: gter dang gter min dbye ba 'byed pa ni: kho mo mtsho rgyal bdag gi snying gtam yin: chos 'di skal ldan bu dang 'phrad par shog: dam nyams log rtog can la 'di ma 'phrad: bka' srung dregs pa rnam gsum gnyer gyis shig: sa ma ya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: sbas rgya: : ces pa 'di yang bu slob rnams kyi bzhed skong du kun bzang bde skyong chos nyid dbang mos nyams chos yig ris su bris pa'o//

he he/ gter min brdzun tshig 'di 'dra ngal ba'i rgyu// rang gzhan 284) gnyis phung dge sbyor g.yeng ba'i gzhi// 'bri 'dun bsam pa gting nas med mod kyang*// 'dren ston chos rje grub dbang rig pa 'dzin// gter chen bla ma rnams kyi bka' gnang dang*// bu slob skyes bu rnams kyi 'dod don bzhin// gang dran yig ris bris pa ma gtogs pa'i// rang che nga rgyal la sogs nyon mongs kyis// rgyud bslad tshig gcig bris pa bdag la med// de phyir gter dang gter min 'byed ma shes// dpyod ldan bu slob rnams kyis mkhyen par mdzod// bde ba'i rdo rjes so//
